DOJO

Seishinkai Karate Federation — Nango Branch

[Nango LUCY Karate Class, Shiroishi Ward / Seishinkai Nango Branch]
The Nango LUCY Karate Class held trial sessions starting in June 2018 (Heisei 30), and began full-scale activities in July of the same year.
The Nango Branch is a Junior Karate / Parent-Child Karate class held inside the Coop Sapporo "Lucy Cultural School."
Because it's inside Coop Sapporo, parents can shop while their children practice, which is very convenient.
While many dojos feel like an extension of school sports-club activities, we aim for karate as health and fitness training — practicing and learning together in a relaxed, club-like atmosphere.

Dojo / Branch Address / Venue Training Days
● Nango Branch (Lucy Cultural School) Sakaedori 18-chome, Shiroishi-ku, Sapporo, Coop Sapporo (Lucy Cultural School) Wednesday 16:00–17:00

● As this is an instructor-dispatch class, please direct inquiries to the Lucy Cultural School (TEL 011-851-8760 / FAX 011-851-8765) or the Seishinkai office (TEL 011-300-0048).

Seishinkai Lucy Nango Branch

◆ Founded: June 2018 (Heisei 30)
◆ Past instructors: Muroki, Takigami, Wakabayashi
◆ Instructor: Muroki

Venue

5-35 Sakaedori 18-chome, Shiroishi-ku, Sapporo, Coop Sapporo Lucy Cultural School (near Nangou Subway Station)
For details and to register for the class, please see the Coop Sapporo Lucy Cultural School website.
